review:
The USA's 250th birthday on Trueways reels. Six or more coins start Coin Respin, where only coins land and the starting coins stay put.

A progressive system unlocks the Mega jackpot, so the scatters you collect over time actually matter. Very high volatility, 5,000x max and 96.7% RTP, with free spins about once every 229 spins. Same proven maths as Wild West Trueways and Olympus Trueways.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
